invocations.note: start; killed from outside with its third request in flight: the first window leaves no pacing entry and no summary
a resume the harness refuses (its request cap below what the run has sent), after it has raised the request left in flight: no preflight, so no invocation
resume; the run's lock is lost before the fourth request, whose line is written but never sent: an error stop (LockLost, exit 1)
resume; the unsent request raised to the most a request can cost, and the run completes
